> *Find *$gg ( x )$* by substituting the function *$\mathrm{g} ( x )$*into the function *$\mathrm{g} ( x )$*. *

$\begin{array}{rcl} \text{gg} ( x ) & = 1 - 2 ( \mathrm{g} ( x ) ) \\ = 1 - 2 ( 1 - 2 x ) \end{array}$

> *Expand the brackets and simplify.*

$\begin{gathered} \text{gg} ( x ) & = 1 - ( 2 - 4 x ) \\ = 1 - 2 + 4 x \\ = - 1 + 4 x \end{gathered}$

**[1]**

> *Find *$\mathrm{g} ( x ) \mathrm{g} ( x )$* by multiplying the function *$\mathrm{g} ( x )$*by the function *$\mathrm{g} ( x )$*. *

$\begin{array}{rcl} \mathrm{g} ( x ) \mathrm{g} ( x ) & = ( 1 - 2 x ) ( 1 - 2 x ) \end{array}$

> *Expand the brackets and simplify.*

$\begin{gathered} \mathrm{g} ( x ) \mathrm{g} ( x ) & = 1 ( 1 - 2 x ) - 2 ( 1 - 2 x ) \\ = 1 - 2 x - 2 x + 4 x^{2} \\ = 1 - 4 x + 4 x^{2} \end{gathered}$

**[1]**

> *Substitute into *$g(x)g(x)-\mathrm{gg}(x)$*.*

$\begin{array}{rcl} \mathrm{g} ( x ) \mathrm{g} ( x ) - \text{gg} ( x ) & = ( 1 - 4 x + 4 x^{2} ) - ( - 1 + 4 x ) \end{array}$

**[1]**

> *Expand and simplify.*

$\begin{array}{rcl} \mathrm{g} ( x ) \mathrm{g} ( x ) - \text{gg} ( x ) & = 1 - 4 x + 4 x^{2} + 1 - 4 x \\ = 2 - 8 x + 4 x^{2} \end{array}$
